name: com.fragmentsunity.importer
description: Native importer for ThatOpen Fragments 2.0 (.frag) BIM files with complete IFC metadata: GlobalIds, property sets, quantity sets, materials with layer thicknesses, classifications, and the Project > Site > Building > Storey > Element spatial hierarchy.

samples.description: Import a .frag file, click an element to log its GlobalId, category and storey, and filter the model by level and category.
